newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Katyusha rockets hit northern Israel.
newsitem.headline: Katyusha rockets hit northern Israel.

text.p: Katyusha rockets fired from south Lebanon slammed into northern Israel on Wednesday, security sources said.
It was not immediately clear if anyone was injured.
The rocket attack increased the tension north in Israel's border where Islamic Hizbollah militants wage a guerrilla war to oust Israeli soldiers from the 15 km (nine mile) border zone.
A mine that exploded in south Lebanon early on Wednesday wounded three Israeli soldiers, security sources said.
Pro-Israeli militia sources in Lebanon said one Israeli soldier was killed and four were wounded in a clash later on Wednesday with guerrillas in the occupation zone.
Around 1,000 Israeli troops patrol the zone carved out in 1985 to prevent cross-border raids.
